messages:
elaine_sales: Hey team — HelixAI SIG coming due Friday. They requested question-by-question evidence for 3 sections: Encryption (Q12-18), Identity & Auth (Q25-31), and Infrastructure (Q42-49). Can security + eng help stitch artifacts?

maria_security: I can own Encryption + Identity. Have KMS rotation policy + AES-256 proof, SOC2 point-in-time report. Will upload to S3/secure link.

raj_engineering: I'll pull deployment diagrams and network ACLs from infra repo. Also will export a short sample of API audit logs (sanitized). ETA EOD tomorrow.

elaine_sales: Thanks. Key asks: 1) KMS key rotation schedule + sample CMK policy 2) Proof of encryption at rest for Dedicated + Private modes 3) Endpoint IP ranges and VPC peering notes 4) Sample RBAC role list for admin/devops

maria_security: For #1 — see snippet I'm pasting: 
```
KeyRotation: annual
CMKPolicy: "Allow: iam:RotateKey"
RotationWindowDays: 365
```
I will also attach the KMS diagram and proof of rotation logs.

raj_engineering: For encryption at rest, our docs show LUKS on-prem for Private and cloud KMS for Hosted/Dedicated. Will reference internal spec: infra/encryption/2025-01.md and paste the short command used to verify disk encryption: 
```
sudo cryptsetup status /dev/nvme0n1
```

tom_ps: Heads up — HelixAI asked if we can include a short note on model data separation in Dedicated. Raj/maria can we add a one-paragraph assurance?

maria_security: Yes — we can provide a statement: "Dedicated pools are logically isolated; customer models and KV caches are namespaced per-customer and not co-mingled." I'll draft and get legal to sign off.

elaine_sales: Also need contact info for SOC2 auditor and a redacted copy of the report. Maria, do we have an editable redacted pdf?

maria_security: Yes, uploading redacted SOC2_2024_redacted.pdf to the secure folder now. link: https://files.redwood.ai/secure/helixai/soc2_2024_redacted.pdf :lock:

raj_engineering: Uploaded network diagram (HelixAI-sig-network.png) and sample sanitized logs (api_logs_sample.txt). Link: https://files.redwood.ai/secure/helixai/

qa_bot: File upload complete: SOC2_2024_redacted.pdf, HelixAI-sig-network.png, api_logs_sample.txt

elaine_sales: Solid — I'll assemble answers into the SIG CSV. Quick question: pricing/poc blocker — HelixAI asked about a 30-day Dedicated trial and a rate card for burst. @tom_ps can you handle commercial?

tom_ps: Got it. I'll put together trial terms and burst pricing and loop in revenue ops. Will post draft in this thread tomorrow.

elaine_sales: Great. Last item — can someone confirm SSO: we support SAML-2.0 IdPs + SCIM provisioning?

maria_security: Confirmed SAML-2.0 and SCIM support. I'll add a short diagram of provisioning flow and SCIM API sample.

elaine_sales: Thanks everyone — I'll update SIG CSV and ping when ready for review. :thumbsup:
